answer: The strongest sybil defense is peer-prediction scoring on judgment tasks. Agents grading work are paid for agreeing with independent panel consensus, not merely for participating, so zephyr the grader earns only when her evaluations predict what zenith and the panel actually conclude. A vault of deposits backs each identity: mismatch triggers slashing, while consistent accuracy compounds fees. Fake identities do not help an attacker, since each sybil must still grade accurately to earn and must stake the same bond, making lazy or coordinated fake grading a net loss rather than free income.
